scope: Individual review of legal parking, continuous land access and a usable fishing bank for every maintained record.
method: Manager sources and public land or access maps were checked against individually inspected aerial imagery. ArcGIS coordinates use actual returned extents. A public facility point alone cannot establish access to an adjoining bank.
limitations: Evidence supports the mapped legal route under stated access conditions. Tree cover, changing water levels, active works and conflicting access records are documented individually. Unsupported precise coordinates are withheld; unresolved or blocked routes remain inactive.
